dct_title_s: Suggestive plan for the improvement of Lake Nokomis as a resevoir for maintaining Minnehaha Falls, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan showing suggestions for the improvement of Lake Nokomis to improve its role as a resevoir for Minnehaha Falls, in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Twenty-eighth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 116.
